company_name: THINTECH MATERIALS TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD. LUKE BRANCH
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in sputtering targets and vapor deposition materials crucial for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Thintech Materials Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on producing sputtering targets and vapor deposition materials for the semiconductor and flat panel display industries. They are expanding their product offerings to include special alloys and have recently collaborated with China Steel Precision Materials to enhance their capabilities in semiconductor packaging.
capabilities: Vapor deposition materials for flat panel displays

regional_presence.China: The company operates as a subsidiary of China Steel Group, focusing on the domestic market and collaborating with local manufacturers.
